description: Defines the SensorsHalAidl class implementing sensor HAL interface with methods for sensor management, event posting, wake lock handling, and sensor addition, specific to Android sensor hardware abstraction layer.

classes.name: SensorsHalAidl
classes.description: Implements sensor HAL interface, manages sensors, events, wake locks, and communication with sensor hardware.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a sensor based on handle.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Configures batch parameters for a sensor.

methods.name: configDirectReport
methods.description: Configures direct report for a sensor channel.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes sensor data for a handle.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the sensor HAL with event queues and callback.

methods.name: postEvents
methods.description: Posts sensor events to the event queue, manages wake lock if needed.

methods.name: AddSensor
methods.description: Template method to add a new sensor to the sensor map.

methods.name: deleteEventFlag
methods.description: Deletes the event flag used for signaling.

methods.name: startReadWakeLockThread
methods.description: Starts the thread to read wake lock FMQ.

methods.name: readWakeLockFMQ
methods.description: Reads from the wake lock FMQ and updates wake lock state.

methods.name: updateWakeLock
methods.description: Manages acquiring and releasing wake lock based on events.
